tasks.title: Step 10: History UI, AI assistant & Docker delivery
tasks.body: Finish the last documented step: the history modal with a working side-by-side diff, the BYOK AI assistant and the one-click error fix, and a Docker image that serves the API, the client and a real LaTeX-to-PDF compile. Verify with the three-headed protocol (vitest, tsc --noEmit, runtime probe) and tag checkpoint-step-10-full-delivery.
